  CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.d1) AS INT) AS BIGINT) AS "v"
FROM dt AS dt
GROUP BY
  dt.id,
  CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.d1) AS INT)
ORDER BY
  "dt.id" ASC,
  "v" ASC
